item.title: Ford Plant Worker Who Heckled Donald Trump Has Been Suspended
item.description: A worker in Ford's plant in Michigan has been suspended after he heckled US President Donald Trump during the latter's visit.

item.title: DoorDash and Uber Allegedly Withheld $550 Million in Delivery Worker Tips
item.description: New York City officials say DoorDash and Uber Eats cost delivery workers $550 million by changing how tips are collected.

item.title: Elon Musk's Tesla Agrees to Mediation in US Workplace Racism Case
item.description: Tesla has agreed to mediation with the EEOC over claims of widespread racism at its California factory.

item.title: Australia's Parliament Erupts Over Climate Funding Amid Bushfire Crisis
item.description: Parliament resumed Wednesday with lawmakers locked in heated debates over climate resilience funding and economic recovery measures, as the nation confronts the twin challenges of devastating bushfires and slowing growth.

item.title: A Short Flight, A Faster Recovery: Why Australians Are Turning to Vinmec in Vietnam
item.description: Vietnam is emerging as a considered option for Australian patients via Vinmec which offers high-end orthopaedic surgery with coordinated recovery pathways.

item.title: How a Small Australian Firm Built the World's Most Imitated iPad Case
item.description: School systems reported high annual replacement spending, with some districts in the United States noting double-digit breakage rates among student-issued devices. Accessory makers moved to fill the gap, but few produced solutions built for the realities of daily use. STM Goods recognised the pattern forming earlier than most.

item.title: Bandcamp Bans AI-Generated Music to Keep the Platform 'Human' in Its Latest Policy
item.description: Bandcamp has updated its policy that bans AI-generated music on its platform in an effort to keep it "human."

item.title: X Updates Grok to Avoid Producing Fake Bikini Photos, Bars Access to Non-Subscribers
item.description: X is finally taking action on Grok's AI image editing capabilities by preventing it from editing real photos into bikini shots.

item.title: US Suspends Immigrant Visa Processing for 75 Countries—Is Australia Included?
item.description: The United States has announced that it will suspend immigrant visa processing for a total of 75 countries. Is Australia on the list?

item.title: ACCC Issues Recall of Hand Sanitiser Over Presence of Methanol
item.description: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) has issued a recall of Dr Schwartz Hand Sanitiser
